scope: Complete eighth numbered juan of the selected YiXueWang transcription; not the preliminary juan or preface.
word_count_method: Latin-letter tokens, including hyphenated and apostrophized forms, within translated blocks; image markup and footnote references excluded. Includes headings and attribution labels; excludes endnotes and project front matter.

collation.type: selective comparison of transcriptions and historical page images
collation.note: The documented 抑 reading in Limitation is supported by a separate transmission of Cheng Yi, not by the consulted Zhezhong transcriptions or page image. Local working copies of the parallel HTML are not part of the committed repository.

review.automated_validation_scope: Coverage, correspondence of commentarial roles, notes, images, and file integrity; not a proof of semantic accuracy.
